'''Krzysztof Paweł Pawłowski''' (26 June 1946 – 3 May 2026) was a Polish politician. A member of the [[Solidarity Citizens' Committee]] and the [[Party of Christian Democrats]], he served in the [[Senate of Poland|Senate]] from 1989 to 1993.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ww2.senat.pl/k2/senat/Senator/pawlowsk.htm|title=Krzysztof Paweł Pawłowski|work=Senate of Poland|language=Polish}}</ref>

Pawłowski died on 3 May 2026, at the age of 79.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=3 May 2026|title=Nie żyje dr Krzysztof Pawłowski. Twórca WSB-NLU i jedna z najważniejszych postaci Sądecczyzny|url=https://miastons.pl/nowy-sacz/nie-zyje-dr-krzysztof-pawlowski-tworca-wsb-nlu-i-jedna-z-najwazniejszych-postaci-sadecczyzny/|trans-title= |work=miastoNS.pl|language=Polish|location= |publisher= |access-date=4 May 2026}}</ref>
